deck.name: planeswalkers
deck.summary:
Jace, Multiverse Architect leads a patient planeswalker deck built around Reality Fracture's empowered Jace tokens, shared loyalty abilities, and life-gain synergies. Establish fixing and defenders, then use the Way enchantments to make each planeswalker contribute to a growing engine of cards, creatures, and loyalty. Jace, Reality Sculptor is the chief library-based finisher, while Sanctum Lurker supplies repeated drain and the token army offers a combat route through Ajani and Elspeth. Transformation effects add variety to longer games. The deck gives up early aggression and a streamlined creature lineup in exchange for a broad, resilient engine, but still depends on protecting its support permanents and planeswalkers.

The quality model grades this deck at the precon baseline against the top lists of the format: few of the cards are ones the top lists of the format play, and that lowers the grade. Many of the cards appear in no top list, and that lowers the grade. The cards pair in ways the top lists do not, and that lowers the grade.
